The easiest thing is to get a new band, but I like to come up with creative fixes too.  
1. Determine the ideal position for the loop.  
2. Drill two tiny holes in the existing band. I have drills smaller than 1/32". You could force a pin through using pliers for grip on the pin.  
3. Find suitable leather from an old coat or shoe upper.  
4. Cut a donor piece the size of the loop that you want.  
5. Sew the two ends of the loop to the base of the band using the two holes made above. You would use the two holes as well as wind the thread around the outside edge of the band.  
6. Use nylon thread if possible for strength.
